Mara Vega

Job: Commander

Twenty years in orbit, three of them in charge of this station. Knows every bolt by its first name, still checks the airlocks herself before bed, and has never once been late for a docking.

Tomas Okafor

Job: Engineer

Keeps the power on and the water clean. Spends his free time building a clock out of spare parts that has never once shown the right time, and says that is the point.

Ines Lindqvist

Job: Pilot

Flies the supply runs and the rescue drills. Holds the station record for the softest docking, and reminds everyone of it at dinner, every dinner, without fail.

Kenji Arano

Job: Botanist

Grows the tomatoes, the beans and the only flowers for four hundred kilometres. Talks to the plants every morning, and claims that they answer.
